agent.finish_summary: Fixed regression in sqlparse/engine/statement_splitter.py: _change_splitlevel had an inverted punctuation check (value != ')') causing every non-')' punctuation token (commas, periods, etc.) to incorrectly decrement the split level, corrupting statement-splitting logic (psql quoting, issue83, issue193, and related cases). Corrected the condition to value == ')' so only actual closing parens decrement the level. Verified with ad-hoc smoke tests (split counts for comma lists, function calls, dollar-quoted function bodies all correct), then removed the temporary test file.
